name: movieglu-pp-mcp
description: Docs-derived contract for MovieGlu movie, cinema, showtime, and cinema booking-link discovery.

movieglu_credentials.title: MovieGlu API key
movieglu_credentials.description: The x-api-key value from the MovieGlu evaluation-credentials email.

movieglu_client.title: MovieGlu client
movieglu_client.description: The client username from the MovieGlu evaluation-credentials email.

movieglu_authorization.title: MovieGlu authorization
movieglu_authorization.description: The authorization value from the MovieGlu evaluation-credentials email.

movieglu_territory.title: MovieGlu territory
movieglu_territory.description: Two-letter country code licensed for these credentials, such as US.

movieglu_geolocation.title: MovieGlu geolocation
movieglu_geolocation.description: Default latitude and longitude separated by a semicolon, such as 40.7128;-74.0060.
